items.text: GreyNoise has now seen 6 break-ins through the flaw under most websites, all on its own decoy servers, from one attacker. Still no real victim named.
The Justice Department charged five people over 'ghost student' financial-aid fraud with more than $32 million in losses; officials say fraudsters used AI to do the coursework.
On Tuesday, voters in 38 local jurisdictions in 10 states decide at least 41 measures to delay, ban or limit data centers.
Pennsylvania has no law against AI-faked candidates in ads; an AI Shapiro in his rival's ad talks for about 45 seconds before saying he isn't real.
